text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Worried about the Japanese Derby, Matikanefukukitaru pays a visit to a shrine to ask a favor of the gods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She happens to see Silence Suzuka, another entrant in the Japanese Derby, while she's there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka says she has come to pray that she isn't overwhelmed by the monster of a race that is the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru realizes that, despite her amazing talents, Suzuka views her as a rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her concerns put at ease, Matikanefukukitaru offers up her own prayers alongside Silence Suzuka.
